heroTitle: A suspended journey where time whispers to your true
home.heroSub: Human, practical support to help you reconnect with clarity, meaning and authenticity.
home.introTitle: Turning your challenges into opportunities for growth
home.introBody: Intuitive and observant, with an attentive ear, I invite individuals and groups to embark on the adventure of self-discovery — to shape a path that is true to their aspirations and values.

pillars.d: Rediscover your strengths and value them day to day, through personalised tools.
A new role, a career change, starting a business or moving abroad: turning uncertainty into momentum.
Easing anxiety, conflict and complex dynamics, freeing yourself from self-sabotage.

forWho.d: Seeking meaning, confidence and balance, or navigating a personal or professional transition.
To lead performance with poise, without losing yourself, and embody aligned leadership.
Skills development, talent management, stress prevention and an inclusive culture.

home.testiTitle: Support is not a trend — it is a path
home.bandText: Together, we co-create a tailored path, aligned with your values and ambitions.

about.title: Myriam Diougoan Blanch
about.lead: Multilingual coach, psychotherapist and HR consultant for over 15 years.
about.p1: My path began with studies in sociology and the sociology of organisations, followed by a postgraduate degree in HR engineering and psychology. It led me to work across several countries, within EU-funded projects, developing an expertise in managing community funds.
about.p2: HR management, independent trainer, trained in coaching, in Carl Rogers' approach and in NLP: eager to learn, I have deepened my passion for human psychology through complementary approaches. For over 15 years, I have developed an approach that is as spiritual as it is pragmatic.
about.journeyTitle: A career in service of people
about.journeyBody: I began my career in Italy and France in key HR roles: designing and steering training projects, building HR departments, talent-management policies, supporting restructurings. I collaborated with international institutions — the Chamber of Commerce, the University of Genoa, the Liguria and Calabria regions — on the financial management of European projects, all while practising coaching.

values.d: Full, sincere attention to what is said and unsaid.
A protected, secure space where everything can be set down.
For your rhythm, your uniqueness, your story.
Towards yourself and others — resilience is cultivated day by day.

about.whyBody: Because I have lived through many transitions myself: from expatriation to founding a business, from personal loss to professional loss, each followed by a brighter renewal. Multicultural and grounded in the reality of organisations, I offer a warm, safe space to dare to explore, experiment with change and shine.

coaching.title: Coaching, psychotherapy & workshops
coaching.lead: A holistic, caring approach blending coaching, group dynamics and an understanding of multicultural specificities.

items.d: A tailored journey to clarify your aspirations and move forward with confidence.
Cohesion, communication and collective intelligence in service of a shared goal.
Easing anxiety, regulating emotions and finding lasting balance.
Moving past limiting beliefs and self-sabotage, revealing your strengths.
Navigating change, ruptures and grief with care and gentleness.
Collective moments to explore, experiment and integrate new resources.

coaching.methodsSub: Inspired by the best international practices.
coaching.pricingSub: Contact Myriam to confirm fees, session length and arrangements for your request.

rh.title: HR consulting & training
rh.lead: Valuing the potential of your people in service of human, sustainable growth.

items.d: Designing, running and steering bespoke professional-training projects.
Building policies to attract, develop and retain talent.
Diagnosis and programmes to prevent psychosocial risks and improve wellbeing at work.
Restructurings, new roles and transformations, accompanied with method and humanity.

rh.approachBody: Over 15 years serving employment policy, professional training and the economic development of companies internationally — from managing European funds to teaching HR management in a business school. An inclusive, high-performing culture, in service of people.
